Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. SDM670 OSM clock controller

The SDM670 Operating State Manager exposes independent L3, power-cluster,
and performance-cluster domains. The controller owns the CPU frequency table
and adds OPP entries for CPU and L3 consumers at probe time.

Properties:
- compatible: required, must be "qcom,clk-cpu-osm-sdm670".
- reg: three memory regions in L3, power-cluster, performance-cluster order.
- reg-names: "osm_l3_base", "osm_pwrcl_base", "osm_perfcl_base".
- qcom,mx-turbo-freq: optional three-frequency array (Hz) marking the first
  rate requiring a TURBO vote on the MX rail, in L3/power/perf order.
- vdd_l3_mx_ao-supply and vdd_pwrcl_mx_ao-supply: required when
  qcom,mx-turbo-freq is present; phandles to MX active-only regulators.
- l3-devs: optional phandle list of devices receiving L3 OPP entries.
- clocks / clock-names: required XO active-only clock, named "xo_ao".
- #clock-cells: required and must be <1>.

Example:
	clock_cpucc: qcom,cpucc@17d41000 {
		compatible = "qcom,clk-cpu-osm-sdm670";
		reg = <0x17d41000 0x1400>,
		      <0x17d43000 0x1400>,
		      <0x17d45800 0x1400>;
		reg-names = "osm_l3_base", "osm_pwrcl_base", "osm_perfcl_base";
		vdd_l3_mx_ao-supply = <&pm660l_s1_level_ao>;
		vdd_pwrcl_mx_ao-supply = <&pm660l_s1_level_ao>;
		qcom,mx-turbo-freq = <1440000000 1708000000 3300000001>;
		l3-devs = <&l3_cpu0 &l3_cpu6 &l3_cdsp>;
		clock-names = "xo_ao";
		clocks = <&clock_rpmh RPMH_CXO_CLK_A>;
		#clock-cells = <1>;
	};
